sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The institutional Government page identifies equatorialguinea-evisa.com as the operational visa site and says interested visitors can obtain a visa online without attending in person.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility, regular passport and delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live English translation asset says all nationalities can apply, limits the process to a regular passport, and sends eVisas by email with PDF download.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E- Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

policies.title: Iraqi ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use the Iraqi ordinary passport issued through the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs service. The separately described laissez-passer is a return-only document and is not this route. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.
Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current document does not identify an Iraqi ordinary-passport exception; this is medium confidence.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Iraqi ordinary passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present it for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Iraqi ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Use the Iraqi ordinary passport used for travel; the live asset excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register using the Iraqi ordinary passport for travel.
Pay and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record for final immigration processing.
